* Keep LOC, dependencies, compile time and binary size as low as possible. The best changes consolidate duplicate logic, simplify or put several lines into one. For new features, try to keep the impact minimal.
* Do not artificially wrap comments below the project's character limit. Let a sentence run past the line limit rather than splitting it mid-thought.
* RickView doesn't have unit tests, so you need to verify the generated HTML.
* To every commit title, add ", generated by AGENT_NAME", for example ", generated by OpenCode".
* To every pull request, add "*generated by AGENT_NAME*" as a last line in italics, for example "*generated by OpenCode*".
* If you know the specific model, add that as well, for example "generated by OpenCode | DeepSeek V4.1 Flash".
* Set the appropriate labels in issues and PRs, also milestones if that is obvious by the user's intent (by default the next numbered release milestone) and assign @KonradHoeffner if you can.
